step_a: Within each panel, close the marked cells along the episode-selected first axis (rows for row_then_column; columns for column_then_row).
step_b: Close each first-stage mask along the other axis, align the panel masks, count per-cell coverage, and paint cyan where at least two panels cover the cell.
why_b_depends_on_a: The second-axis spans and the final majority counts are computed from cells created by step A; changing the first closure changes which cells step B can span and changes the final cyan mask.
